facts.fact: The Ministry of Commerce held a two-phase national stakeholder workshop on strengthening the e-commerce regulatory framework, in Kara on 21 January 2025 and Lomé on 24 January 2025, with businesses, consumer associations, regulators and financial service operators taking part.
